title: Print PDF preview
intro: Uses the current book selection and manuscript assembler to produce one paginated PDF. The on-screen preview and exported copy use identical bytes.
layoutHelp: Font, size, indentation, paragraph spacing and margins come from the options on the left. Chapters start on new pages, with mirrored binding gutters.
confirmWarnings: I reviewed these warnings and allow PDF generation from this draft / range
progress: A separate local browser process is typesetting, with a 60-second limit. It does not open your browser window or call AI / remote fonts.
exported: Saved with the same hash as the preview.
emptyTitle: Confirm the range, then inspect real pages
emptyHelp: Generate to browse page by page. TXT, Word and EPUB remain available when local Edge / Chrome is unavailable.
viewerError: The page could not be displayed. You can still download the generated PDF for inspection.
snapshot: This is the manuscript snapshot captured at generation time. Regenerate after editing text or settings. Export copies the currently previewed file without re-typesetting it.
longParagraph: Chapter {{chapter}} · Source line {{line}}: long paragraph of {{count}} characters
limits: Widow/orphan avoidance is applied, but the browser has no reliable location-by-location widow detector. No automatic pass is invented. Source paragraphs over 1,000 characters are flagged for inspection without editing prose.
fontFallback: System fonts are used, with possible fallback for missing glyphs. Unusual glyphs, cover cropping and physical print results still need manual page inspection.
offline: Uses installed local Edge / Chrome with a separate temporary profile and blocked external content. No font download or browsing of other websites.
leftHelp: Choose paper and generate on the right. The current font and selection are reused. PDF snapshots do not change other export formats.
jumpChapter: Jump to a verified chapter start
cancelled: Print job cancelled. No late result was opened. Existing preview and manuscript are unchanged.
cancelTooLate: Typesetting finished before it could stop. Waiting was stopped and the new result was not opened. Regenerate if needed.
cancelFailed: The server has not confirmed stopping. You may retry cancel; a late result will not open automatically.
alreadyRunning: This book already has a print request. Wait for it or cancel the current request.
sourceCurrent: Verified: preview matches saved manuscript revisions
sourceChanged: The manuscript changed: this preview is an older snapshot
sourceUnknown: Not all manuscript revisions could be verified
allowSnapshot: I understand this is not a verified current manuscript; export/download this fixed snapshot anyway
snapshotConsentRequired: The manuscript changed or could not be verified. Regenerate, or explicitly allow exporting the current older snapshot.
requestConflict: This print request ID belongs to different settings. Generate again; a mismatched PDF will not be reused.
